mapper.sql: cfv.formula_version_id as "formulaVersionId", cfv.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", cfv.formula_code as "formulaCode", cfv.calculation_type as "calculationType", case cfv.calculation_type when 'FIXED_SCORE' then '정액배점' when 'DISTRIBUTION_RATE' then '배분율적용' when 'CAP' then '상한적용' when 'LADDER' then '구간별배점' else cfv.calculation_type end as "calculationTypeName", cfv.variable_definition::text as "variableDefinition", cfv.rounding_rule as "roundingRule", cfv.lower_bound_score as "lowerBoundScore", cfv.upper_bound_score as "upperBoundScore", cfv.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", cfv.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", cfv.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", cfv.active_yn as "activeYn", cfv.change_reason as "changeReason", cfv.updated_by as "updatedBy", cfv.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from calculation_formula_versions cfv inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = cfv.rule_version_id

where.if: and (cfv.formula_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or cfv.calculation_type ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or cfv.rounding_rule ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or cfv.variable_definition::text ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into calculation_formula_versions (rule_version_id, formula_code, calculation_type, variable_definition, rounding_rule, lower_bound_score, upper_bound_score, evaluation_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.formulaCode}, #{request.calculationType}, CAST(#{request.variableDefinition} AS jsonb), #{request.roundingRule}, #{request.lowerBoundScore}, #{request.upperBoundScore}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.effectiveStartDate}, #{request.effectiveEndDate}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, formula_code, evaluation_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date) do update set calculation_type = EXCLUDED.calculation_type, variable_definition = EXCLUDED.variable_definition, rounding_rule = EXCLUDED.rounding_rule, lower_bound_score = EXCLUDED.lower_bound_score, upper_bound_score = EXCLUDED.upper_bound_score, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
